rules.description: R_Option => Right-click (Alone) or R_Option (With other keys).
Caps_Lock => Escape (Alone) or Left_Shift (With other keys).
CTRL-S => Option+Left (jump word backward) excluding terminals.
CTRL-G => Option+Right (jump word forward) excluding terminals.
CTRL-W => Option+Delete (delete word before) excluding terminals.
CTRL-X => Fn+Option+Delete (delete word ahead) excluding terminals.
CTRL-U => Cmd+Delete (delete all before) excluding terminals.
